policy.p0: Existing seed geometry fixed; only exact duplicate/winding normalization. No coordinate or ownership changes.
operations: round P1 to existing seed's 5-place coordinate lattice
intersect each P1 with fixed P0
attach an actual P0 residual polygon only to its unique positive-length adjacent P1
policy.fallback: Any invalid P1, empty clipped feature, excessive adjustment, ambiguous/unattached residual, failed overlay, invalid result or failed equality replaces the entire country's P1 selection with its unchanged P0 as ONE territory. Record every excluded source identity. Never delete an error within a selected partition.
policy.fallbackLimitation: Country remains selectable with the same owner and outline, but occupation is whole-country only; no partial occupation inside that country.
policy.locks: P0 is fixed before alignment. Final P1 boundaries are locked only after successful alignment and verification. No later merges/cap avoidance across either lock.
policy.noFiller: Residuals are exact P0-minus-P1 geometry, not invented polygons. If unique adjacency cannot be proven, use whole-country fallback; never add a residual filler territory.

selectionPolicy.p0: Existing seed geometry fixed; only exact duplicate/winding normalization. No coordinate or ownership changes.
operations: round P1 to existing seed's 5-place coordinate lattice
intersect each P1 with fixed P0
attach an actual P0 residual polygon only to its unique positive-length adjacent P1
selectionPolicy.fallback: Any invalid P1, empty clipped feature, excessive adjustment, ambiguous/unattached residual, failed overlay, invalid result or failed equality replaces the entire country's P1 selection with its unchanged P0 as ONE territory. Record every excluded source identity. Never delete an error within a selected partition.
selectionPolicy.fallbackLimitation: Country remains selectable with the same owner and outline, but occupation is whole-country only; no partial occupation inside that country.
selectionPolicy.locks: P0 is fixed before alignment. Final P1 boundaries are locked only after successful alignment and verification. No later merges/cap avoidance across either lock.
selectionPolicy.noFiller: Residuals are exact P0-minus-P1 geometry, not invented polygons. If unique adjacency cannot be proven, use whole-country fallback; never add a residual filler territory.

operations: reverse ring winding to source-specific policy
repairPolicy.coordinatePrecision: preserve every original IEEE-754 coordinate; no rounding or quantization
repairPolicy.coverageRule: same ordered features, properties, geometry types, components, holes and undirected nonzero segment multiset per ring
repairPolicy.topologyPolicy: Any remaining defect requires independently justified, versioned topology repair or replacement source; blocked, never silently repaired.

containmentPolicy.mandatoryFutureGate: Recheck full equality, cross-country ownership and final caps after any 14-6/14-7 generation; drift blocks publication.
